Write-Host "--- samples diff ---"; git -C $main diff --exit-code HEAD -- docs data_file examples; Write-Host "diff exit: $LASTEXITCODE"

python "$main\scripts\verify_acceptance.py" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20
